onnx.preprocessing: letterbox (pad to square with 114,114,114), NOT stretch

torchscript.preprocessing: letterbox (pad to square with 114,114,114), NOT stretch

tflite.preprocessing: letterbox (pad to square with 114,114,114), NOT stretch

tflite.nms: already applied by the exporter (litert_torch converter bakes it in regardless of the nms=False export flag) - do not run NMS again in the app for this file

notes: Per-class deploy_conf = the confidence that hit target precision on the test set - use it as the alert threshold. App also runs an N-of-M temporal debounce; flood must never trigger a reroute. Prefer model.tflite with the ultralytics_yolo plugin - its output is already NMS-decoded, just filter rows by deploy_conf per class. ONNX/TorchScript are raw-head fallbacks only, and need you to write decode+NMS yourself in the app.
